svg.data-spec:
title: Control plane API writes kind: flow dir: down
req: Resource write | POST, PUT, DELETE @gray
[Control plane API] blue lock: Namespace lock | if an admission reads it fresh: Version current? | If-Match or resourceVersion admit: Admitted? | mutate, then validate dry: Dry run? | ?dryRun=true write: Write | conditional on the version r409: 409 Conflict @red r4xx: Refused | 400, 403, 409 or 413 @red plan: Answer | admitted, not stored @gray [/]
[Storage layer] coral meta: Metastore | Badger @db [/]
req > lock > fresh fresh > admit: yes fresh > r409: no admit > dry: yes admit > r4xx: no dry > plan: yes dry > write: no write > Storage layer
